blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions. Thermal imaging offers a promising contactless alternative to traditional methods, which often rely on partially invasive sensors or obtrusive wearable systems. However, existing approaches for $f_R$ estimation from thermal signals typically require extensive pre-processing and manual or semi-automatic region-of-interest (ROI) tracking, limiting their practical applicability. This study proposes a deep learning-based method for estimating $f_R$ directly from thermal videos, eliminating the need for complex pre-processing and ROI tracking. A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) is developed to operate on raw thermal video data. To address challenges related to small datasets, the model is trained using data augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a validation $R^2$ score of approximately 0.61 on both pre-processed and raw thermal videos. By simplifying the workflow, this method holds promise for enhancing the feasibility of thermal imaging in real-world applications, such as remote healthcare and driver monitoring in automotive applications.
blocks.zh: 监测呼吸率(f_R$)等生理参数对诊断和管理各种病理条件至关重要。 热成像为传统方法提供了有希望的无接触替代方法,传统方法往往依赖部分侵入式传感器或可穿透性系统. 然而,目前采用的办法包括: 来自热信号的雷亚尔估计通常需要大量的预处理和人工或半自动利益区追踪,限制其实际适用性。 本研究提出了基于深入学习的估算f_美元的方法. 直接从热视频获得R$,从而不再需要复杂的预处理和ROI跟踪. 开发了一个3D 革命神经网络(3D-CNN),在原始热视频数据上运行. 为应对与小数据集有关的挑战,该模型通过使用数据增强和从合成数据集中学习的转移来进行培训。 实验结果表明,拟议办法在预处理和原始热视频上都取得了约0.61美元的验证结果。 通过简化工作流程,这种方法有望加强实时应用中的热成像的可行性,例如远程保健和汽车应用中的驱动器监测。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Respiratory rate, also known as respiratory frequency ( f R f_{\mathrm{R}} ), is a vital sign of significant importance sensitive to different pathological conditions and stressors.
Within the healthcare field, it is used for diagnosing, prognosing, and managing pneumonia [ 1 ] . Moreover, there is significant evidence indicating that f R f_{\mathrm{R}} serves as a crucial predictor for clinical deterioration and cardiac arrest [ 2 , 3 ] . In addition, the f R f_{\mathrm{R}} is an indicator in neonatal intensive care units [ 4 , 5 ] . Indeed, respiratory diseases stand out as a primary cause of morbidity among neonates, with a higher prevalence among preterm infants [ 6 ] . Monitoring respiration, specifically f R f_{\mathrm{R}} , aids in detecting sudden infant death syndrome, one of the major causes of death in infants [ 7 , 8 ] .
In the field of psychophysiology, f R f_{\mathrm{R}} serves as a reliable indicator of mental stress and cognitive load. It proves valuable for assessing stress levels not only in workplace and computer-related tasks but also in the contexts of aviation and automotive to assess stress levels or drowsiness in pilots and drivers [ 2 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
Finally, f R f_{\mathrm{R}} is a reliable indicator of physical effort and fatigue [ 13 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
呼吸速率也叫呼吸频率(fR f_{\mathrm{R}}-),是对于不同病理条件和应激反应器具有显著敏感性的重要标志.
在保健领域,它被用于诊断、预测和管理肺炎 [一]. 此外,有重要证据表明fR f_{\-mathrm{R}}-是临床恶化和心脏停止的关键预测器[2,3]. 此外,fR f_{\mathrm{R}}是新生儿特别护理单位[4,5]的一个指标. 事实上,呼吸道疾病是新生儿发病的主要原因,早产婴儿的发病率较高。 监测呼吸,特别是fR f_{\mathrm{R}}, 帮助检测婴儿突然死亡综合征,这是婴儿死亡的主要原因之一 [7, 8].
在心理生理学领域,fR f_{\-mathrm{R}}-是精神压力和认知负荷的可靠指标. 事实证明,这不仅对评估工作场所和计算机相关任务的压力程度,而且对评估飞行员和驾驶员的压力程度或疲软程度[2、9、10、11、12]而言,对评估航空和汽车压力程度都是有益的。
最后,fR fQ_{\mathrm{R}}是体力和疲劳的可靠指标 [13,14].

blocks.en:
Nonetheless, f R f_{\mathrm{R}} remains one of the least documented and underestimated vital signs in clinical practice, mainly due to limitations in current clinical monitoring techniques [ 15 , 14 , 16 , 17 , 3 ] . Indeed, manual counting of respiratory cycles is still performed in cardio-respiratory resuscitation, posing a challenging task even for trained professionals, and yielding subjective outcomes [ 3 ] . Other modalities rely on the attachment of sensors to the patient’s body, which induces stress and discomfort. Indeed, sensor placement in psychophysiology has the limitation of potentially altering the natural psychophysiological behavior of the subject monitored. Furthermore, the removal of adhesive electrodes often leads to epidermal stripping and skin disruption in neonatal intensive care [ 18 ] .
To overcome these limitations, contactless methods have been proposed to monitor respiration [ 2 ] .
In particular, InfraRed Thermography (IRT) has been taking hold because of the great advantage of remotely monitoring the infrared radiation emitted by objects, enabling passive and non-intrusive monitoring of skin temperature.
Unlike visible recordings, IRT remains unaffected by lighting conditions and can function in the darkness, making it well-suited for monitoring drivers or conducting sleep studies. Notably, respiratory cycles are visible to the naked eye in IRT, as exhaled air, being warmer than inhaled air, generates observable variations in radiation intensity or temperature within the nasal/nostrils region of interest (ROI).
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,f-f-f-mathrm{R}}仍然是临床实践中记录最少并被低估的生命迹象之一,这主要是因为目前临床监测技术的局限性[15,14,16,17,3]. 事实上,人工计算呼吸周期仍然是在心肺呼吸复苏中进行的,即使对受过训练的专业人员来说,也是一种挑战性的任务,并产生了主观结果[3]。 其他方式依赖于感应器附着在病人的身体上,这会引起压力和不适. 事实上,在心理生理学中放置传感器的局限性在于有可能改变受监测对象的自然心理生理学行为。 此外,取出胶合电极往往导致新生儿重症监护中皮质脱落和皮肤被打乱[18].
为克服这些局限性,提出了无接触方法来监测呼吸[2]。
特别是,红外线热能学(IRT)由于远程监测物体所发射的红外线辐射的极大优势而得以维持,从而能够对皮肤温度进行被动和非侵入性监测。
与可见录音不同,IRT仍然不受照明条件的影响,可以在黑暗中发挥作用,使其适合监测驱动器或进行睡眠研究. 值得注意的是,呼吸循环在IRT的肉眼中是可见的,作为吸入空气,比吸入空气更温暖,在引起关注的鼻腔/鼻孔区域(ROI)内产生辐射强度或温度的可观察到的变化.

blocks.en:
Therefore, most imaging methods for f R f_{\mathrm{R}} monitoring involve identifying and tracking specific features or anatomic landmarks to extract the respiration signal by averaging the temperature of the pixels within a chosen ROI, such as the nose or nostrils, over time. For instance, [ 19 ] introduced a network of probabilistic trackers to segment the nostril region and exploited wavelet analysis to reconstruct the breathing information. A related approach was followed in Abbas et al. [ 20 ] for neonatal non-contact monitoring of the respiratory activity. The ROI was defined in the first frame and no tracking algorithm was used. Building on this, Pereira et al. [ 8 ] manually selected the nose region in the first frame and applied a tracking algorithm to compensate for the motion in the following frames. In [ 21 ] , the authors proposed a method to automatically detect the respiration region using Canny edge detector.
The contribution outlined in [ 22 ] consists of a real-time tracking of human nostrils using an ensemble of regression trees. The authors demonstrate its robustness in scenarios involving head motion and object occlusion. Other studies suggested to consider not only temperature modulation around the mouth and nostrils but also the body movements, detecting respiration by blending the temperature change of ROIs and breathing motion [ 23 , 24 ] . A multi-sensor approach, using both visible and infrared technologies, to increase the robustness and reliability of region detection and tracking has been used in [ 24 , 25 ] . Similarly, Scebba et al. fused the information obtained in the near-IR and far-IR spectra from the nostril and chest [ 26 ] . They extracted multiple streams of respiratory information from independent video modalities and then applied two dedicated data fusion models to determine whether the subject was breathing, and at which frequency. Yet, a noteworthy limitation of these studies lies in the demand for sophisticated algorithms not only to detect and track specific regions of interest but also to accomplish frame registration across diverse modalities.
ROI detection to identify the nose in IR videos in order to extract breathing-relevant pixels can be particularly challenging if the videos have low contrast or suffer from suboptimal focusing. These conditions may compromise the overall robustness of the approach, making accurate ROI detection more challenging and potentially affecting the reliability of breathing signal extraction. To skip the region selection and tracking procedure, Scebba et al. [ 27 ] extracted respiration signals based on pixel time series, avoiding image segmentation. However, they cropped the frames around the nose, making the algorithm still region-based. A grid-based approach, which does not use any anatomical region selection, was proposed in [ 18 ] to estimate f R f_{\mathrm{R}} . A signal quality index was empirically developed to automatically distinguish ROI in the video containing the respiratory signal from those containing only noise. They used Bayesian fusion of the selected ROIs to get robust estimations for f R f_{\mathrm{R}} . The major drawback of the proposed algorithm is the sensitivity to motion artifacts. Moreover, both ROI-based and grid-based approaches require adequate pre-processing of the recordings to ensure a reasonable signal to noise ratio of the extracted breathing signal.

[8]手动选择了第一个帧中的鼻区域,并应用了跟踪算法来补偿以下帧中的运动. 在[21]中,作者提出了使用Canny边缘探测器自动检测呼吸区域的方法.
[22]中概述的贡献包括利用回归树群实时跟踪人类鼻孔. 作者们在涉及头部运动和物体被遮住的情景中证明了它的强性. 其他研究建议不仅考虑口腔和鼻孔周围的温度调节,而且考虑身体运动,通过混合ROIs的温度变化和呼吸运动来检测呼吸[23,24]. 在[24、25]中采用了多传感器方法,使用可见和红外技术来提高区域探测和跟踪的强度和可靠性。 与此相类似,Scebba等人著. 将取自鼻孔和胸口的近IR和远IR光谱中的信息整合起来[26]. 他们从独立的视频模式中提取出多条呼吸道信息流,然后应用了两个专用的数据聚变模型来确定主体是否呼吸,以及频率. 然而,这些研究的一个值得注意的局限性在于,不仅需要尖端算法来探测和跟踪具体感兴趣的区域,而且需要完成不同模式的框架登记。
ROI检测在IR视频中识别出鼻孔,以提取出与呼吸相关的像素,如果视频的对比度低或注意力不够理想,则可能尤其具有挑战性. 这些条件可能损害方法的整体稳健性,使准确的ROI检测更具挑战性并可能影响呼吸信号提取的可靠性. 为跳过区域选择和跟踪程序,Scebba等人。 [27] 根据像素时间序列提取出呼吸信号,避免了图像分割. 然而,他们把相框绕出鼻子,使得算法仍然以区域为基础. 在[18]中提出了不使用任何解剖区域选择的以网格为基础的方法,以估计fR f_{\-mathrm{R}}. 根据经验开发了一个信号质量指数,以自动区分包含呼吸道信号的视频中的ROI和只包含噪音的视频. 他们利用Bayesian对选定的ROI进行核聚变来获得fR f_{\mathrm{R}}]的强力估计. 拟议算法的主要缺点是对运动文物的敏感性. 此外,基于ROI和网格的方法都需要对录音进行充分的预处理,以确保提取出呼吸信号的信号与噪声比例合理。

blocks.en:
In this study, a new approach to predict the f R f_{\mathrm{R}} from thermal videos using deep learning is proposed. Ultimately, our objective was to develop a model capable of operating directly on raw thermal videos, eliminating the need for additional pre-processing steps. In the literature, deep learning methods were used for face detection and face tracking, and to infer stress and drowsiness levels from thermal imaging of people’s breathing patterns [ 28 , 29 ] .
However, to the best of the authors’ knowledge, this is the first attempt to employ end-to-end deep learning for direct extraction of respiratory signals from thermal videos. With this work, the limitations of ROI-based f R f_{\mathrm{R}} extraction are addressed and the need for intense pre-processing of the thermal videos is removed.
Specifically, a 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) was employed to analyze the thermal video and predict the corresponding f R f_{\mathrm{R}} . The model was trained and evaluated using f R f_{\mathrm{R}} data extracted through a standard protocol from the respiratory signal obtained via a chest belt, used as reference. In addition, an innovative and creative data augmentation procedure is introduced to address the constraints posed by small datasets, a common limitation of deep learning in healthcare applications. To validate the approach a Leave-Subject-Out strategy is adopted to avoid the bias due to the presence of the same subject in both training and test set. This approach enhanced the generalization capability of the model, allowing it to work effectively on previously unseen subjects. Finally, the investigation was extended to both processed and raw thermal videos. This allowed model performance comparison across multiple scenarios, ensuring a comprehensive assessment of its capabilities.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,建议采用一种新方法,利用深入的学习,从热视频中预测fR f_{\mathrm{R}}. 最终,我们的目标是开发一种能够直接在生热视频上操作的模型,从而不需要额外的预处理步骤. 在文献中,使用了深层的学习方法来进行面部检测和面部跟踪,并从人们呼吸规律的热成像推断出压力和昏沉的程度[28,29].
然而,据提交人所知,这是利用端到端深入学习直接从热视频提取呼吸道信号的第一次尝试。 通过这项工作,解决了基于ROI的f-R f-_{\mathrm{R-}}取取出的限制,并消除了热视频的剧烈预处理需要.
具体来说,一个3D 革命神经网络(3D-CNN)被用来分析热视频并预测相应的f R f_{\ mathrm{R}}. 该模型通过一个标准协议从通过胸带得到的呼吸道信号中提取出fR f_{\-mathrm{R}}-数据进行训练和评价,作为参考. 此外,还引入了创新和有创意的数据扩充程序,以解决小数据集造成的制约,这是在保健应用方面深入学习的一个共同限制。 为了验证这一方法,采用了一个“留学-Subject-Out”战略,以避免由于在培训和测试中都存在同一科目而导致的偏差。 这种方法增强了模型的通俗化能力,使其能够有效地处理以前未见的主题。 最后,调查范围扩大到经过处理的和原始的热视频。 这样可以对多种情景进行模型性能比较,确保对其能力进行全面评估。

blocks.en: 2 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Subjects Recruitment, Experimental Protocol and Acquisition Set-up
blocks.zh: 2.1 招生、实验协议和采购设置

blocks.en: Thirty healthy volunteers (age range of 26.6 ± \pm 3.6 years, 20 females), with no history of cardiovascular or mental disorders, participated in this study. The experiments were approved by the Bioethics Committee of the University of Pisa (no. 85 15/2019), and each volunteer signed the informed consent. The subjects were asked to avoid alcohol, caffeine, and physical exercise for 24 hours before the experimental session. They were also asked not to use make-up and/or moisturizers for the experiment and not to shave within 48 hours before the session.
blocks.zh: 30名健康志愿者(年龄范围26.6 ±\pm 3.6岁,20名女性),没有心血管或精神障碍史,参加了这项研究。 比萨大学生物伦理学委员会批准了这些实验(第85 15/2019号),每个志愿人员都签署了知情同意书。 在实验会召开前24小时,要求实验对象避免酗酒,咖啡因和体能锻炼. 还要求他们不要在试验中使用化妆和/或润湿剂,并且不要在开会前48小时内刮胡子。

blocks.en:
During the experiment, standard procedures for IR imaging acquisition are followed [ 30 ] . Participants were seated in a comfortable chair
in a controlled environment, far from ventilation and radiation sources. Temperature and humidity were kept in the range of approximately 24–26 ∘ C and 40–60 % \% , respectively. Within the same experimental session, the temperature change never exceeded 1 ∘ C and humidity variation was a maximum of 5 % \% . Before the start of the experiment, the subjects acclimatized for at least 10 minutes to the testing environment.
blocks.zh:
实验期间,遵循IR成像获取的标准程序[30]. 与会者坐在一个舒适的椅子上
远离通风和辐射源 温度和湿度分别保持在大约24-26克和40-60%克之间。 在同一个实验环节中,气温变化从未超过1°C,湿度变化最大为5%. 在实验开始前,实验对象对试验环境至少进行了10分钟的适应.

blocks.en:
Facial thermograms were acquired using a FLIR T640 thermal camera with a 24.6 mm lens.
The camera features a Focal Plane Array (FPA) size of 640 × 480 640\times 480 , corresponding to 307,200 uncooled microbolometer detectors, with no interpolation applied, Noise Equivalent Differential Temperature (NETD) < < 0.04 mK @ +30 ∘ C and spectral range of 7.8–14 μ \mu m in the Long Wave InfraRed (LWIR). The sampling frequency was 5 Hz. The camera’s emissivity was set to 0.98, the recommended value for a human body surface, and it was placed at a fixed distance of 1 meter from the face of the subject. Twenty minutes before the start of the recording, the camera was turned on to allow for sensor stabilization. Their respiratory signal was simultaneously acquired using a BIOPAC MP150 system, with a piezoelectric chest belt, at a sampling rate of 250 Hz.
blocks.zh:
利用一台装有24.6毫米透镜的FLIR T640热相机购置了外形热克.
相机上设有焦相平面阵列(FPA)尺寸为640×480 640\times 480,对应307200个未冷却的微波计探测器,没有应用插值,噪声等分分温度(NETD) < 0.04 mK @+30 + C,光谱范围为长波红外线(LWIR)7.8–14 μ\mu m. 取样频率为5赫兹. 相机的放电率被设定为0.98,即人体表面的推荐值,并被放置在与主体相距1米的固定距离上. 录音开始前20分钟,相机被打开,以便传感器稳定. 他们的呼吸信号同时被使用BIOPAC MP150系统获得,并带有一个比佐电压胸带,采样率为250赫兹.

blocks.en: The experimental protocol, as illustrated in Fig. 1 , was designed to alter the respiratory frequency of the subjects during the different 5-minute tasks.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,实验协议旨在改变受试者在不同5分钟任务中的呼吸频率。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Experimental timeline showing the succession of 5-min tasks administered to each subject. After an initial acclimatization period (dashed line), participants underwent a baseline resting phase, followed by a Stroop test (cognitive stress induction), a second resting period, and an emotional elicitation task using affective images.
blocks.zh: 图 1:实验时间表,显示每个学科所执行的5分任务的接续情况. 在最初的适应期(干线)之后,参与者经历了一个基线休息阶段,然后是Stroop测试(认知压力感应)、第二个休息期,以及利用情感图像进行情感诱导。

blocks.en: Specifically, the protocol involved alternating between resting phases and mental and emotional stimulation. The first task involved a Stroop test [ 31 ] , previously employed in stress classification based on respiratory frequency [ 28 ] . This task required participants to rapidly solve incongruous stimuli, with a buzzer alerting them for each missed or incorrect answer, as detailed in [ 32 ] . The second task consisted of displaying a sequence of images, selected from the International Affective Picture System (IAPS) database, to the subjects. This public database is a consistent and effective resource for eliciting emotions [ 33 ] . In particular, pictures with high arousal and negative valence were presented to the participant one after the other, for 5 seconds each.
blocks.zh: 具体而言,协议涉及休息阶段与精神和情感刺激之间的交替。 第一项任务涉及一次斯特罗普测试[31],该测试以前用于基于呼吸频率的压力分类[28]. 这项任务要求与会者迅速解决不协调的刺激问题,并配备一个拨号器,提醒他们注意每一个漏发或不正确的答案,详见[32]. 第二项任务包括显示一系列图像,从国际动感相片系统(IAPS)数据库中选取到主题. 这个公共数据库是引出情绪的一致而有效的资源[33]. 特别是,向与会者逐一展示了具有高振荡和负能的相片,每次5秒。

blocks.en: Overall, the range of variability of respiratory frequency in the dataset is between 9 and 30 cycles per minute, see the evolution of f R f_{\mathrm{R}} over time for 5 test subjects in Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh: 总体而言,数据集中呼吸道频率的可变性范围为每分钟9至30个周期,参见fR f_{\mathrm{R}}在Fig. 9中5个测试对象随时间推移而演变.

blocks.en:
The experimental setup is visualized in Fig. 2 .
The interested reader is referred to [ 34 ] for further details about the experimental setup, the protocol, and an exploratory analysis of the measured variables.
blocks.zh:
实验设置在图2中可视化.
感兴趣的读者请参看[34] 关于实验设置、协议以及对所测量变量的探索性分析的进一步细节。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the experimental setup. The participant was seated in a thermally controlled room, facing a FLIR T640 thermal camera positioned at a 1-meter distance. The thermal camera acquired infrared facial images, while a chest belt connected to a BIOPAC MP150 system recorded the reference respiratory signal. The setup ensured synchronized acquisition of both contactless and ground-truth respiratory data.
blocks.zh: 图 2:实验设置概况. 该与会者坐在一个受热控制的房间,面对位于一米距离的FLIR T640热相机。 热相机获得了红外线面部图像,而连接到BIOPAC MP150系统的胸带记录了参考呼吸道信号. 这一设置确保同步获取无接触和地上真实的呼吸系统数据。

blocks.en: 2.2 Thermal Recording Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 热记录预处理

blocks.en: The thermal frames were coregistered to reduce motion using a dense optical flow algorithm as in [ 35 ] . All frames were spatially Gaussian smoothed to remove high-frequency noise. Moreover, the original IR frames were downsized to 60 × 80 60\times 80 pixels, effectively reducing their original size by a factor of 8, in order to lower the computational load.
blocks.zh: 热相框被联合注册,以便像[35]中那样使用密集光学流算法来减少运动. 所有相框在空间上都是高斯平滑地去除高频噪声. 此外,原有的IR帧被缩小为60×80 60\times 80像素,为降低计算负荷,有效地将原来的尺寸缩小了8倍.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Sequence of four consecutive unprocessed IR frames downsampled to 60 × 80 60\times 80 pixels.
blocks.zh: 图3:连续四个未经处理的IR帧的序列被下取样为60×80 60\times 80像素.

blocks.en: A mask to remove the background and the eyes was applied to all frames before the analysis. In particular, the eyes were excluded to remove blinking artifacts. The face segmentation mask was created by shaping an ellipse centered in the nose tip, with a minor axis length equal to the width of the face (being determined by the location of landmarks close to the ears) and a major axis length equal to twice the distance between the nose tip and the chin landmarks. Thermal and visible frames were registered using a Local Weighted Mean transformation, which outperforms other geometrical transformations [ 36 ] . Facial landmarks were identified in the RGB frames using the Yuval Nirkin algorithm [ 37 ] . Analogously, the ellipses to exclude the eyes were automatically determined based on the landmarks’ location.
blocks.zh: 在分析前,所有帧都应用了去除背景和眼睛的口罩. 特别是,眼睛被排除去取出闪烁的文物. 面部分化口罩由以鼻尖为中心而成的椭圆形而来,其细轴长度与相面的宽度相当(由近耳的地标位置所决定),而主轴长度则相距于鼻尖和下巴地标相距相距的两倍. 热和可见相框采用局部加权平均值变换法注册,其性能超过了其他几何变换法 [36]. 利用"尤瓦尔·尼尔金"算法在RGB帧中确定了地标. [37]. 同样,排除眼睛的椭圆是自动根据地标位置确定的。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Sequence of four consecutive pre-processed IR frames. A mask is applied to suppress the background and the eye region.
blocks.zh: 图4:连续四个被预处理的IR框架的序列. 口罩用于压制背景和眼睛区域.

blocks.en:
In the paper, the respiratory frequency reconstruction algorithm will be assessed both on
the unprocessed IR videos (downsampled to 60 × 80 60\times 80 pixel to reduce the computational complexity) and on the IR videos pre-processed as described in the previous paragraphs, see Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 , respectively.
blocks.zh:
在论文中,将评估呼吸频率重建算法。
未处理的IR视频(下标为60×80 60\times 80像素以降低计算复杂度)和前面段落所描述的IR预处理视频上,分别参见图3和图4.

blocks.en: 2.3 Reference Respiratory Frequency
blocks.zh: 2.3 参考呼吸频率

blocks.en:
The respiratory signal was used to extract the respiratory frequency ( f R f_{\mathrm{R}} ), which then served as the target output for training and evaluating the model. The identification of f R f_{\mathrm{R}} from the respiratory signal involved pinpointing the maximum peak within the
frequency spectrum, specifically within the range of 0.15 to 0.55 Hz.
The frequency spectrum was obtained using the Fast Fourier Transform, applied to a sliding window of 30-second long signals with 29 seconds of overlap. This approach aimed to capture the dynamic changes in f R f_{\mathrm{R}} over each 5-minute task period.
blocks.zh:
呼吸道信号被用来提取呼吸道频率(fR f_{\-mat-mathrm{R}}-),后作为训练和评价模型的目标输出. 从呼吸道信号中识别出 fR mathrm{R}} 涉及在
频率频谱,具体在0.15至0.55赫兹范围内.
频率谱是使用快取Fourier Transform获得的,被应用到一个有29秒重叠的30秒长信号的滑动窗口上. 这种方法旨在捕捉每个5分钟任务期内fR f_{\mathrm{R}}的动态变化.

blocks.en: 2.4 Deep Learning - 3D-CNN
blocks.zh: 2.4 深入学习 - 3D-CNN系统

blocks.en: The 3D Convolutional Neural Network [ 38 ] is a deep-learning architecture designed to process three-dimensional data objects such as molecular structure (three spatial dimensions) and videos (one temporal and two spatial dimensions). Recently, this architecture has been successfully applied to predict the protein-ligand interaction [ 39 ] and for human action recognition from videos [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 三维革命神经网络[38]是一个深层学习架构,旨在处理分子结构(三个空间维度)和视频(一个时间和两个空间维度)等三维数据对象. 最近,这一架构被成功应用来预测蛋白质-韧带相互作用[39],并用于视频中人类行动识别[40].

blocks.en:
In this paper, a 3D-CNN is used to reconstruct the respiratory frequency f R f_{\mathrm{R}} from the measured IR video stream.
Overall, the network receives as input a tensor of dimension 150 × 60 × 80 150\times 60\times 80 , corresponding to a 30-second video stream at sampling frequency of 5 Hz (thus, 150 frames) and resolution 60 × 80 60\times 80 pixels, and produces as output a single scalar value representing the mean respiratory frequency over the same time window.
The network architecture comprises three 3D convolutional layers interleaved with Max Pooling operations, followed by two dense layers, as illustrated in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh:
在本文中,一个3D-CNN用于从所测量的IR视频流中重建呼吸道频率fR f_{\mathrm{R}}.
总体而言,网络作为输入收录了维度为150×60×80 150\时60\时80分,相当于取样频率为5Hz(至此为150帧)和分辨率为60×80 60\时80像素的30秒视频流,并输出出代表同一时间窗口平均呼吸频率的单平面值.
网络架构由三个与Max Pooling操作相接的3D相生地层组成,再由两个密集地层组成,如图5所示.

blocks.en: Figure 5: The 3D-CNN architecture used in this study. Each 3D convolutional layer employs a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernel with stride and padding set to 1 1 , while max pooling layers use a 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 kernel. ReLU activation functions are applied after each convolutional and dense layer, except for the final dense layer with output dimension of 1 1 , which directly outputs the frequency prediction. The dimensions of the network’s input, output, and intermediate activations are indicated below each corresponding block.
blocks.zh: 图5 本研究采用的3D-CNN架构. 每个3D相生层使用3×3相生3相生3相生3相生3相生3相生的内核,并设置为1相生1相生,而最大相生集合层使用2相生2相生2相生2相生2相生2相生2相生. RELU活化功能在每一个回转层和密集层后被应用,除了输出维度为1 1 的最后密集层,它直接输出频率预测. 网络的输入、输出和中间活化的维度在每个相应的块下标明。

blocks.en:
Input and output instances for training are obtained by extracting sequences of 150 consecutive IR frames from the longer experiment videos, together with the mean respiratory frequencies in the corresponding 30-second periods.
A sliding window of one single frame is used, i.e. all possible (partially overlapping) 150-length sequences are fed to the model during training.
Moreover, to cope with the relatively small size of the available dataset,
the extracted video segments are transformed by randomized data augmentation operations that include noise corruption, blurring, distortions, and rotations, according to the RandAugment algorithm [ 41 ] , see Fig. 6 .
These transformations are aimed at improving the generalization property of the trained model and tackle, at least in part, the overfitting issue commonly encountered when the training dataset lacks either quantity or diversity [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh:
培训的输入和输出实例是通过从较长的实验视频中取出150个连续IR帧的序列,以及相应的30秒期间的平均呼吸频率得到的.
使用一个单一框架的滑动窗口,即在训练期间向模型输入所有可能的(部分重叠的)150长序列。
此外,为了应付现有数据集规模较小的问题,
根据RandAugment算法[41],所提取的视频片段通过随机数据增强操作进行转换,这些操作包括噪声腐败、模糊、扭曲和旋转,参见图6。
这些转变旨在改进训练有素模式的一般特性,并至少部分地解决培训数据集缺乏数量或多样性时普遍遇到的过度适应问题[42]。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Augmented frames from the unprocessed IR dataset. The RandAugment algorithm is applied to the frames in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 图6:未处理的IR数据集的增强框架. RandAugment算法被应用于图3中的帧.

blocks.en: To further enhance generalization, a sim-to-real transfer learning approach [ 43 ] from an initial model learned over a synthetic dataset is followed. Specifically, synthetic video segments are generated by combining fixed facial backgrounds with a simulated respiratory activity. The latter is implemented by superposing two pulsating circles with randomized position, size, and pulsation frequency to the fixed backgrounds, thereby mimicking the behavior of nostrils (see Fig. 7 ). The same data augmentation approaches mentioned in the previous paragraph are applied to the synthetic dataset, increasing the complexity of the corresponding learning problem.
blocks.zh: 为进一步加强通俗化,采用了从合成数据集上学习的初始模型中的模拟到实际转移学习方法[43]。 具体而言,合成视频段是通过将固定面部背景与模拟呼吸活性相结合来生成的. 后者通过将两个具有随机位置,大小,脉冲频率的脉冲圆圈叠加到固定背景来实施,从而模仿了鼻孔的行为(见图7). 上段中提到的同样的数据增强方法适用于合成数据集,增加了相应学习问题的复杂性.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Frames extracted from the synthetic dataset. Pulsating circles around the nostril region simulate the respiratory activity.
blocks.zh: 图 7: 从合成数据集取出的框架. 在鼻孔区域周围打出圆圈来模拟呼吸活性.

blocks.en:
While the synthetic dataset is a simplified representation of the real-world respiratory activity, it enables the generation of an arbitrarily large amount of training instances. This synthetic dataset is used to train the 3D-CNN until full convergence without overfitting issues, although on a slightly different—and possibly simpler—learning problem. The small real dataset is ultimately employed solely to fine-tune the 3D-CNN previously trained on synthetic data. This is necessary to align it with the true data distribution corresponding to the real-world respiration activity.
Notably, we anticipate that the synthetic data approach has demonstrated remarkable efficacy in mitigating overfitting and consequently improving the generalization results.
blocks.zh:
虽然合成数据集简化了真实世界呼吸活性的表现,但它能够产生任意的大量培训案例。 这种合成数据集用于训练3D-CNN,直到完全汇合,而不过分适应问题,尽管在一个稍有不同、可能更简单的学习问题上。 小型真实数据集最终仅用于微调之前接受过合成数据培训的3D-CNN. 这对于使其与真实世界呼吸活动对应的真实数据分布一致是必要的.
值得注意的是,我们预计,合成数据方法在缓解过度调整从而改进通俗化结果方面已显示出显著的功效。

blocks.en: It is worth remarking that the selection of the 3D-CNN in this study was guided by preliminary experiments on synthetic videos, which indicated that it is slightly easier to train for this task compared to other architectures of similar complexity, such as Long-term Recurrent Convolutional Networks [ 44 ] . Other architectures, including the recently developed Video Vision Transformers [ 45 ] , may also be viable. However, alternative architectures were not further explored, as the primary challenge lies in data scarcity, which is addressed through data augmentation and synthetic data generation.
blocks.zh: 值得指出的是,本研究中3D-CNN的选取是以合成视频的初步实验为指导的,这些实验表明,与具有类似复杂性的其他建筑相比,为完成这项任务而进行培训略为容易一些,例如:长期经常性革命网络[44]. 其他建筑,包括最近开发的Video Vision变形器[45],也可能可行. 然而,没有进一步探讨替代结构,因为主要的挑战在于数据稀缺,而数据稀缺是通过数据扩充和合成数据生成来解决的。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Training setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 培训机构

blocks.en: A large portion of the dataset was used for training, comprising frames from 25 out of the 30 available subjects, while the remaining 5 were held out as a validation set for performance assessment. The training loss function was set to the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between the reference respiratory frequency f R f_{\mathrm{R}} extracted as described in Section 2.3 and the neural network output, while for performance evaluation both the MSE and the coefficient of determination R 2 R^{2} were considered.
blocks.zh: 很大一部分数据集用于培训,包括30个现有科目中的25个,其余5个是作为绩效评估的验证单元。 培训损失功能被设定为参考呼吸道频率f f---------- mathrm{---------(如第2.3节所描述)与神经网络输出之间的平均平方误差(MSE),而为了进行性能评价,则考虑了MSE和确定系数R-2-----2}。

blocks.en:
Initially, architecture and training hyperparameters were optimized on the synthetic dataset to establish a baseline for comparison, leveraging Bayesian optimization [ 46 ] to tune crucial parameters such as the learning rate, batch size, number of layers and internal channels of the architecture across multiple training instances.
In this investigation, the architecture depicted in Fig. 5 , along with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 32, were identified as favorable among the various configurations explored.
blocks.zh:
最初,在合成数据集上优化了建筑与培训超参数,以建立比较基线,利用巴耶斯优化[46]调取关键参数,如学习率,批量大小,层数和建筑内部渠道跨多起培训.
在本次调查中,图5所描绘的建筑,以及10-4-10-QQ-4}的学习率和分批32的大小被确定为在所探讨的各种配置中是有利的.

blocks.en: Training on real data was then conducted over 500 epochs, with the best-performing model selected based on validation performance throughout these epochs. In each epoch, the MSE loss was minimized over the entire training dataset, with minibatches extracted in random order from the dataset to promote diversity in learning. After completion of each training epoch, the MSE and the R 2 R^{2} score are computed on the validation dataset to evaluate the model’s performance.
blocks.zh: 然后,进行了500多个世纪的实际数据培训,根据这些世纪的验证性能选定了最佳模式。 在每个世纪中,MSE损失在整个培训数据集中被最小化,从数据集中随机抽取出小管,以促进学习的多样性. 每次训练结束后,都会在验证数据集上计算MSE和R 2 R^{2}分数,以评估模型的性能。

blocks.en: The base setup described above was adopted in the following experiments, which were repeated for both the original dataset scaled to resolution 60 × 80 60\times 80 (Fig. 3 ) and for the pre-processed dataset (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 上述基础设置在以下实验中被采用,既为被第60×80 60\times 80(图3)号决议所缩放的原始数据集,也为预处理数据集(图4)所重复.

blocks.en: 3.2 Base training
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 基地培训

blocks.en:
The base training setup described above was initially implemented. However, this approach unveiled notable overfitting challenges, as evidenced by the R 2 R^{2} score converging to 1 on the training dataset, while deteriorating on the validation dataset (see Fig. 8 and first column block in Table 1 ).
This highlights the need for augmentation strategies to mitigate overfitting and enhance model generalization.
blocks.zh:
上文所述的基地培训机制最初已经实施。 然而,这种做法暴露出明显与挑战相左,例如R 2 R^{2}在培训数据集上的得分合为一,而在验证数据集上的得分则在恶化(见图8和表1第一栏)。
这突出表明,需要制定增强战略来缓解过度调整和加强模式的普及。

blocks.en: Figure 8: R 2 R^{2} score in training (left) and validation (right) over the training epochs using the base training setup on the unprocessed dataset.
blocks.zh: 图8:R 2 R^{2}在培训(左)和验证(右)的分数,在未处理的数据集上使用基础培训设置,在培训时期取分.

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据增强

blocks.en:
Next, data augmentation was introduced to alleviate the overfitting issue and thus potentially enhance results. Data augmentation was implemented using the RandAugment method [ 41 ] , as implemented in the torchvision library [ 47 ] and described in Section 2.4 .
However, RandAugment alone did not lead to performance improvements, as reported in the second column block of Table 1 .
This outcome suggests that, while standard data augmentation techniques may introduce beneficial variability, they can still fail in an extremely low-data regime, where tailor-made solutions have to be sought for.
blocks.zh:
其次,引入了数据扩充,以缓解过度调整的问题,从而有可能提高成果。 数据扩增使用RandAgment方法[41],在火炬视像库中实施[47],并在第2.4节中描述.
然而,如表1第二栏所报告,单靠RandAugment并没有导致业绩改善。
这一结果表明,虽然标准数据增强技术可能带来有益的可变性,但在数据极其低的制度中,它们仍然可能失败,必须为此寻求量身定制的解决办法。

blocks.en: 3.4 Transfer Learning from Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 3.4 从合成数据学习转移

blocks.en:
The transfer learning approach from the synthetic dataset described in Section 2.4 was finally adopted to improve model generalization performance.
This approach proved highly effective, largely mitigating overfitting issues and yielding significant performance improvements. This is highlighted in the third column block (Synthetic TL) of Table 1 , with a validation R 2 R^{2} of 0.488 and 0.521 on the original and pre-processed datasets, respectively.
blocks.zh:
第2.4节所描述的合成数据集的转移学习方法被最终采用来提高模型通化性能.
事实证明,这种做法非常有效,在很大程度上减轻了过度调整的问题并导致显著的业绩改善。 表1第三栏块(合成TL)突出显示这一点,在原始和预处理数据集上分别验证R 2 R^{2}为0.488和0.521.

blocks.en:
Finally, the combination of Transfer Learning from Synthetic Data with Data Augmentation using RandAugment was tested. The achieved results reported in last column block (Augmentation + Synthetic TL) of Table 1 demonstrate the advantage of this combined approach. Indeed, the validation R 2 R^{2} increases to 0.604/0.614 on the original/pre-processed IR frames.
Interestingly, while Data Augmentation does not lead to any performance improvement when used alone, it provides a substantial performance boost when it is combined with the
Synthetic Data Transfer Learning approach.
In Fig. 9 , the predictions of the resulting model on the validation dataset are compared to the actual values. Additionally, Fig. 10 displays the confusion matrix for the same validation dataset, with labels derived by dividing the frequency output range into ten equally spaced intervals. Note that the model accurately predicts trends in respiratory frequency, as well as the overall order of magnitude of the signal.
blocks.zh:
最后,通过RandAugment测试了从合成数据中转移学习与数据增强的结合. 表1上一栏(增强+合成TL)所汇报的已取得的成果表明了这一综合方法的优势。 实际上,R 2 R^{2}的验证在原始/预处理的IR框架上增加到了0.604/0.614。
有趣的是,虽然数据增强在单独使用时不会导致任何性能的改善,但如果将数据增强与数据增强结合起来,则会产生实质性性能提升。
合成数据传输 学习方法。
入法义. 9,在验证数据集上对产生的模型的预测与实际值进行比较. 此外,图10显示同一验证数据集的混淆矩阵,通过将频率输出范围分为10个等距间隔来得到标签. 注意该模型准确预测了呼吸道频率的趋势,以及信号的总的大小顺序.

blocks.en: Figure 9: True and predicted values of the model trained on the unprocessed dataset, for all non-overlapping 150-frame segments of the validation split.
blocks.zh: 图9:未处理数据集培训的模型真实值和预测值,用于所有未重叠的150帧分解验证.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Confusion matrix of the model’s predictions on the validation dataset. Labels are obtained by dividing the frequency range into ten equally spaced intervals. The concentration of values along the main diagonal indicates consistent predictive performance.
blocks.zh: 图10:模型在验证数据集上的预测的混淆矩阵. 标签是通过将频率范围分为10个等距间隔获得的. 沿主对角的数值浓度表明一致的预测性能.

blocks.en: Table 1: Validation MSE and R 2 R^{2} obtained on the unprocessed and pre-processed IR datasets with the different training strategies. Best results in bold.
blocks.zh: 表1:用不同训练策略在未处理和预处理的IR数据集上获得的验证MSE和R 2 R^{2}. 最佳成绩为粗体.

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows all the activations of the second convolutional layer for the trained 3D-CNN (top panel) and of the same network at initialization, thus with random weights (bottom panel). Both networks are fed by the same input video, which corresponds to one of the 5 validation subjects. It is evident that, in the trained network, most of the neurons are focused on the nostril region of the face, in line with our expectations.
blocks.zh: 图11显示训练有素的3D-CNN(顶板)和同个网络在初始化时的所有第二回旋层活化,从而具有随机权重(下板). 两个网络都由相同的输入视频提供,这与5个验证主体之一对应. 显然,在训练有素的网络中,大多数神经元都按照我们的期望,专注于面部的鼻孔区域.

blocks.en:
Figure 11: Activations of the second convolutional layer for the trained 3D-CNN (top panel) and for the 3D-CNN at initialization (bottom panel).
The 8 rows correspond to the channel depth of the layer, and the 37 columns correspond to the reduced time dimension.
In the trained network, several neurons focus on the nostril region, whereas the untrained network shows little to no response in this area.
blocks.zh:
图11:训练有素的3D-CNN(顶板)和3D-CNN在初始化(底板)时的第二演化层活化.
8行对应地层的通道深度,37列对应被缩短的时间尺寸.
在训练有素的网络中,数个神经元聚焦于鼻孔区域,而未训练有素的网络在这方面几乎没有到没有反应.

blocks.en:
To further validate consistency of the results obtained through the synthetic transfer learning approach, 6-fold cross-validation was conducted on the unprocessed data over all the available subjects, resulting in five additional training/validation splits.
In Fig. 12 , the MSE loss and R 2 R^{2} score over the training epochs for the 6 cross-validation splits are shown.
The mean of the validation MSE loss and R 2 R^{2} score over the splits are 0.297 and 0.663, respectively.
This is consistent with the result in the last column of Table 1 , obtained in a simple validation setting.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步验证通过综合转移学习方法获得的结果的一致性,对所有现有科目的未处理数据进行了6倍的交叉验证,结果又进行了5次培训/验证。
在图12中,MSE损失和R 2 R^{2}在6个交叉验证分数的训练时代中得分。
验证MSE损失和R 2 R^{2}分数的平均值分别是0.297和0.663.
这与在简单的验证环境中取得的表1最后一栏的结果是一致的。

blocks.en:
Figure 12: Results of 6-fold cross-validation on the unprocessed dataset, with training performed via augmented synthetic transfer learning.
The mean validation loss ( 0.297 0.297 ) and mean validation R 2 R^{2} score ( 0.663 0.663 ) across the splits are consistent with the results from the simpler validation setting reported in Table 1 ( 0.312 0.312 and 0.604 0.604 , respectively).
blocks.zh:
图12:未加工数据集6倍交叉验证结果,通过强化合成转移学习进行培训。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, a novel approach for estimating respiratory frequency from thermal signals using deep learning techniques, specifically a 3D-CNN, is introduced.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,采用了一种新的方法,利用深层学习技术,特别是3D-CNN,从热信号中估算出呼吸频率。

blocks.en: Compared to traditional approaches, the proposed solution offers an end-to-end framework that eliminates the need for sophisticated pre-processing steps, such as ROI tracking [ 19 ] or eyes/background removal [ 34 ] . This holds promise for simplifying existing pipelines for respiratory monitoring.
blocks.zh: 与传统方法相比,拟议解决方案提供了一个端到端的框架,从而不再需要复杂的预处理步骤,例如ROI跟踪[19]或眼睛/后地清除[34]. 这有望简化现有的呼吸道监测管道。

blocks.en: Traditional methods for respiratory signal extraction from thermal videos typically rely on identifying and tracking specific anatomical landmarks, such as the nostrils or nose. These methods often involve extensive pre-processing to ensure accurate ROI detection and motion compensation. For instance, algorithms utilizing continuous wavelet transforms or Canny edge detectors have shown promise, but are heavily dependent on the quality of ROI detection and tracking [ 48 , 20 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 传统的从热视频中提取呼吸道信号的方法通常依赖于识别和跟踪特定的解剖地标,例如鼻孔或鼻孔. 这些方法往往涉及广泛的预处理,以确保准确的ROI检测和运动补偿. 例如,使用连续波纹变换或Canny边缘探测器的算法显示出希望,但严重依赖ROI探测和跟踪的质量[48、20、21]。

blocks.en:
The need for extensive pre-processing, often involving non-automatic techniques, has been a significant barrier to the practical application of thermography outside controlled laboratory settings. For example, methods requiring manual ROI selection or sophisticated tracking algorithms can be cumbersome and prone to user error [ 49 , 35 , 32 ] . This necessity for strong processing and manual intervention limits the scalability and widespread adoption of thermal imaging technologies in real applications. The presented algorithm, although trained on carefully and ad-hoc pre-processed data, is designed to operate effectively on raw thermal videos. To further validate these claims, both the raw thermal dataset and the pre-processed dataset were used and compared, showing very similar results.
This capability to handle raw data represents a remarkable advancement beyond the state of the art. It opens up numerous possibilities for using thermal imaging in more practical settings, such as remote monitoring, field diagnostics, and real-time surveillance systems, for example, in infant monitoring. The reduced reliance on pre-processing not only streamlines the workflow but also enhances the feasibility of using thermal cameras in diverse and less controlled environments.
blocks.zh:
需要进行广泛的预处理,往往涉及非自动技术,这是在受控制的实验室环境之外实际应用热法的一大障碍。 例如,要求人工ROI选择或复杂的跟踪算法的方法可能繁琐并容易被用户出错[49,35,32]. 这种强有力的加工和人工干预的必要性限制了热成像技术在实际应用中的可伸缩性和广泛采用性。 所呈现的算法虽然在经过认真的和临时的预处理后的数据上受到训练,但是为了在生热视频上有效运行而设计的. 为了进一步核实这些索赔,使用了原始热数据集和预处理数据集并进行了比较,结果非常相近。
这种处理原始数据的能力是超越技术水平的显著进步。 它为在更加实际的环境中使用热成像提供了许多可能性,例如远程监测、实地诊断和实时监测系统,例如婴儿监测。 减少对预处理的依赖不仅简化了工作流程,而且提高了在多样和不受控制的环境中使用热相机的可行性。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, the study addresses the common challenge of overfitting in deep learning models, especially when dealing with small datasets. By employing data augmentation strategies and leveraging transfer learning from a synthetic dataset, the generalization capabilities of the model are significantly improved. The combination of these techniques showed a validation R 2 R^{2} score of approximately 0.61, indicating a reliable performance across different validation sets.
It is worthwhile noting that one of the critical challenges in utilizing thermal cameras for data acquisition is the complexity and cost associated with collecting large high-quality datasets, which are usually needed for deep learning approaches. Not only high quality thermal imaging equipment is often expensive, but also the data collection process can be challenging and time-consuming. In this context, the data augmentation strategy employed in this study presents a significant advantage. By generating synthetic data that mimics real thermal video patterns, the training dataset, which included only thirty subjects, was effectively expanded, allowing the model to learn more generalized features and reduce overfitting.
blocks.zh:
此外,该研究还涉及在深入学习模式中过度适应的共同挑战,特别是在处理小数据集时。 通过采用数据增强策略并借助从合成数据集中学习的转移,该模型的通缩能力得到显著提高. 这些技术的组合显示R 2 R^{2}的验证分数约为0.61分,表明不同验证组之间有可靠的性能.
值得指出的是,利用热相机获取数据的关键挑战之一是收集大型高质量数据集的复杂性和成本,而这些数据集通常是深层学习方法所需要的。 不仅高质量的热成像设备往往很昂贵,而且数据收集过程可能具有挑战性和耗费时间。 在这方面,本研究采用的数据扩充战略具有重大优势。 通过生成模仿真实热视频模式的合成数据,只包括了30个科目的训练数据集得到了有效的扩展,使模型能够学习更通俗的特征并减少过于适应.

blocks.en: This approach is not only beneficial for our specific application, but also holds promise for a wide range of future studies in thermal imaging. For example, researchers working on facial recognition, stress detection, and other physiological signal monitoring using thermal cameras can adopt similar data augmentation techniques to enhance their models’ robustness and performance. The ability to generate high-quality synthetic data reduces the dependency on extensive real-world data collection, thus boosting research ability to propose specific solutions to several research problems and developments in different fields based on thermal imaging.
blocks.zh: 这种方法不仅有利于我们的具体应用,而且对未来热成像的广泛研究很有希望。 例如,从事面部识别,压力检测,以及其他使用热相机进行生理信号监测的研究人员可以采用相类似的数据增强技术来提升其模型的坚固性和性能. 生成高品质合成数据的能力可以降低对广泛的现实世界数据收集的依赖性,从而增强研究能力,为基于热成像的不同领域的几个研究问题和发展提出具体解决方案.

blocks.en: The potential implications of this study are broad and impactful. The ability to accurately extract respiratory signals from thermal videos has significant applications in healthcare, particularly for continuous and non-intrusive monitoring of patients. For example, this can be especially beneficial in neonatal intensive care units, where traditional sensor attachment can be distressing and potentially harmful to the delicate skin of preterm infants. Moreover, in fields such as psychophysiology and driver monitoring, the methodologies proposed in this paper could provide a non-invasive means of assessing respiratory rate, which is a critical indicator of stress and fatigue.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的潜在影响是广泛而有影响的。 从热视频中准确取出呼吸道信号的能力在保健方面有显著的应用,特别是在持续和非侵入性监测病人方面. 例如,在新生儿特别护理单位中,这特别有益,因为传统感官的附着可能令人痛苦并可能对早产婴儿的微妙皮肤造成伤害。 此外,在心理生理学和驱动力监测等领域,本文件中建议的方法可以提供一种非侵入性的方法来评估呼吸道速率,这是压力和疲劳的关键指标.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Works
blocks.zh: 5 限制和未来工程

blocks.en: Despite the promising results, several challenges and limitations remain open for future investigations.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了可喜的结果,但未来调查仍然面临若干挑战和限制。

blocks.en:
While the use of synthetic and augmented data for transfer learning significantly reduces overfitting, these approaches may not fully capture the complexity and variability of real-world respiratory patterns in applications like driver monitoring, where significant head motion is expected.
Additionally, the experimental protocol did not include physical activity, which limited the explored respiratory frequencies to a range of about 9 9 to 30 30 cycles per minute.
blocks.zh:
虽然使用合成和扩充的数据来进行转移学习会大大减少过度适应,但这些方法可能无法充分反映实际世界呼吸模式的复杂性和可变性,如驱动器监测,因为预计在这种应用中头部有重大运动。
此外,实验协议不包括物理活动,这就将所探索的呼吸频率限制在每分钟9至30个周期之间。

blocks.en:
Multiple datasets could be used to assess and possibly improve the robustness of the 3D-CNN approach in those challenging scenarios.
For instance, the multi-modal public domain dataset described in [ 50 ] , which provides thermal/visible-light recordings and physiological signals of human subjects performing distracted driving, could be instrumental to validate the 3D-CNN approach in automotive applications.
blocks.zh:
可以利用多套数据集来评估并可能改进3D-CNN方法在这些具有挑战性的情景中的稳健性。
例如,[50]所描述的多式公有领域数据集为从事分心驾驶的人类主体提供热/可见光记录和生理信号,可能有助于验证汽车应用中的3D-CNN方法。

blocks.en: Tailor-made data augmentation techniques, such as time-varying rotation/translations of the video stream [ 51 ] , may also be applied to robustify the algorithm against head movements. Furthermore, different respiratory frequencies may be explored by altering the reproduction speed of existing recordings.
blocks.zh: 特制数据增强技术,如视频流的时序变化自转/翻译[51]等,也可被应用来强化算法来对抗头部运动. 此外,可以通过改变现有录音的复制速度来探索不同的呼吸频率。

blocks.en:
Future work will also focus on improving the realism and diversity of synthetic data exploiting, for instance,
3D simulation engines and generative artificial intelligence tools.
blocks.zh:
今后的工作还将侧重于改进合成数据的现实主义和多样性,例如:
3D模拟引擎和基因人工智能工具.

blocks.en:
While the respiratory frequency is one of the most commonly
used metrics in affective, clinical, and remote monitoring fields,
many other physiological variables are useful for inferring affective states and to perform wellness analysis.
Future investigations will focus on the reconstruction of different aspects of the respiratory signal such as breathing depth and time quotient [ 52 ] , as well as on the estimation of other physiological signals such as heart rate or blood oxygen levels, to broaden the utility of the presented methodology in healthcare and beyond.
A potential avenue to enhance the robustness of physiological signal reconstruction is the integration of multi-sensor data, combining thermal imaging with other modalities such as visible light or depth cameras.
blocks.zh:
虽然呼吸频率是最常见的之一
使用感官、临床和远程监测领域的计量标准,
许多其他生理变量对推断有影响状态和进行健康分析很有用。
今后的调查将侧重于呼吸信号的不同方面的重建,如呼吸深度和时间商 [52],以及心率或血氧水平等其他生理信号的估计,以扩大所介绍方法在保健及以后的用途.
增强生理信号重建稳健性的一个可能途径是将多传感器数据集成,将热成像与可见光相机或深度相机等其它方式相融合.

blocks.en:
Finally, the original dataset used in this paper relies on high-quality thermal imaging equipment, which may not be accessible in all settings due to cost and dimension constraints.
Investigating the application of the presented methodologies in real-time monitoring systems based on low-cost thermal cameras could open new possibilities for continuous health monitoring in both clinical and non-clinical settings.
blocks.zh:
最后,本文中使用的原始数据集依赖于高质量的热成像设备,由于成本和尺寸的限制,这些设备可能无法在所有环境下访问.
以低成本热相机为基础的实时监测系统对所介绍方法的应用情况进行调查,可以为在临床和非临床环境下持续进行健康监测开辟出新的可能性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In conclusion, this study presents a novel deep learning-based approach for extracting respiratory signals from thermal videos.
The proposed 3D-CNN network was able to reconstruct respiratory frequency with an R 2 R^{2} index of approximately 0.61 0.61 for both raw and pre-processed video signals.
By largely eliminating the need for extensive pre-processing and ROI tracking, the presented methodology simplifies the workflow and enhances robustness. The combination of data augmentation and synthetic transfer learning has proven effective in addressing the challenges of small datasets, resulting in reliable performance across different validation sets. The implications of this work are far-reaching, with potential applications in healthcare, psychophysiology, and beyond. Future research will aim to further refine and extend the capabilities of this approach, ensuring its applicability in diverse real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh:
最后,本研究提出了从热视频中提取呼吸道信号的一种以学习为基础的新型深层方法.
拟议的3D-CNN网络能够重建呼吸频率,原始和预处理的视频信号的R 2 R^{2}指数约为0.61 0.61。
所提出的方法基本上消除了广泛进行预处理和跟踪记录仪的必要性,简化了工作流程,提高了稳健性。 数据增强和合成转移学习相结合,已证明能够有效地应对小数据集的挑战,从而在不同验证组之间产生可靠的性能。 这项工作的影响是深远的,有可能在保健、心理生理学和其他领域应用。 今后的研究将着眼于进一步完善和扩大这一方法的能力,确保其适用于不同的现实世界情景。
